name: Cowardice, Greater
body:
School enchantment (compulsion) [despair, mind-affecting]; Level bard 5, mesmerist 6, psychic 6, sorcerer/wizard 6, spiritualist 6, summoner/unchained summoner 6, witch 6
Duration 1 minute/level

DESCRIPTION

This spell acts as cowardice, except on a failed save, the target becomes hopeless.
